conservative, never less.

KILLS: treating a header with no state line as blocked (reports 1 of 1 blocked, which
is the `blocked == seen` rule satisfied on a single line of evidence). It also pins
that the BLOCKED test applies to the line IMMEDIATELY after the header, so a dump
that stops there cannot contribute a blocked thread.
